decisions.reason: The 15-day express program sits close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, but it overlaps with the broader express line D, so it may be consolidated into that line.
The 72-hour express service supports the firm's promise of fast response and is only mentioned on the website, so it may be folded into D, yet slack in a large, growing firm allows it to continue.
The European-certified fire-resistant exterior door was launched at BAU on the home page and extends a core modular system, so its results likely meet aspirations.
The multi-model express line has its own page and supports the firm's fast-delivery positioning, with no shortfall that would trigger search.
The online ordering and digital service platform fits the firm's direction toward more advisory and service support, and slack lets the firm carry it while its uncertain returns develop.
The fire and smoke protection door is a core, compliance-driven product close to the established offer and is unlikely to fall below aspirations.
